admin_head: Pilar Economia (classificação por programa, Mapa VII)
spending_entity: Ministério da Economia Digital (vote 01.03.02) principally; the programme is cross-vote
programme: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO
line_name: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO
purpose: CABO VERDE PLATAFORMA DIGITAL E DA INOVAÇÃO - programme of the *Economia* pillar. The volume prints the programme title and its financing split and no narrative; there is no printed programme description to quote.
scope_basis: Explicit programme title - the state's own digital platform and innovation programme, the PEDS pillar programme under which the Estratégia da Economia Digital is financed. Single-purpose by title; the whole domestic share is digital.
amount_scale: escudos (units). No scale header anywhere in the volume; proved by cross-footing Tesouro 550,184,541 + OFN 18,000,000 + Donativo 21,000,000 + Empréstimo 1,239,119,344 = Total 1,828,303,885, and by the mapa's grand total 85,948,752,206 matching `Mapa III`.
doc_locator: Lei n.º 35/X/2023, BO I Serie n.º 134 de 31-12-2023, `Mapa VII - Despesa por Programa e Tipo de Financiamento` (PDF p.109); outturn at `Conta Geral do Estado 2024`, `Mapa VII` (PDF pp.179-180)
notes: `Mapa VII - Despesa por Programa e Tipo de Financiamento` is the only table in the Cabo Verdean budget that states a digital line's **purpose** and its **financing origin** together. Its columns are `Tesouro | OFN (Outras Fontes Nacionais) | FCP AAL (Fundo de Contravalor / Ajuda Alimentar) | Donativo | Empréstimos | Total`. **`Tesouro + OFN` is the domestic-state share and is what this record carries**; `Donativo` and `Empréstimos` are external and are excluded by the origin gate. · Why the programme axis and not the ministry vote.** Cabo Verde publishes the vote (`Mapa III`) only as ministry x programme *type* (Investimento / Finalístico / Gestão e Apoio Administrativo) - a programme-type split, not a programme. `Mapa VII` is the finest published grain at which a line's stated purpose is digital, and it is the only one that prints the origin split. Recording both axes would double-count the same escudos, so the organic figures are carried here as context and are not separate records. · The organic axis, for context and not as a record.** `Mapa III` gives `01.03.02 GOV - Ministério Da Economia Digital` **OI CVE 1,390,965,632** (Investimento 553,090,000 + Finalístico 811,792,545 + Gestão e Apoio Administrativo 26,083,087) -> **ORP 1,483,485,681** (553,090,000 + 901,812,594 + 28,583,087) -> **EXE 489,920,474** (**0** + 464,756,445 + 25,164,029) = **33.0% of ORP**, against 80.0% for Finanças, 91.0% for the Presidency and 91.6% for the Tribunal de Contas. Every cell cross-foots. **The digital ministry executed a printed literal zero of its CVE 553,090,000 investment appropriation** - not a data gap: the row's own total cross-foots to it and the thirty other rows on the page carry non-zero investment execution. Source: `Conta Geral do Estado 2024`, `Mapa III` (PDF p.163). · CORRECTION TO THE FY2025 SWEEP RUN FILE, made on reading the documents.** `CPV-2025-run-2026-08-03.md` reads the `Conta Provisória`'s `Nível G0 / G1 / G2 / G3` columns as a **funding-origin** split and reports "47.5% of the digital ministry's reprogrammed budget is external contribution". It is not an origin split. The table is **`Mapa XV - Orçamento Por Níveis de Género e Orgânica`**, and G0-G3 are **gender-responsiveness levels**; the column headed `Total Contribuição Género` is the gender contribution, not external contribution. For FY2024 the same table gives Economia Digital ORP 1,483,485,681 = G0 1,443,559,905 + G1 39,925,776, execution 489,920,474 = G0 463,247,395 + G1 26,673,079, and the printed 66.8% is 26,673,079 divided by 39,925,776 - the gender-contribution execution rate. **The origin split for Cabo Verde is in `Mapa VII` and nowhere else.** · The universal-service fund is inside this perimeter and is not counted twice.** The FY2024 `Anexo Informativo`'s earmarked-revenue table gives `Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)` **CVE 122,073,633**, financed by operator contributions and the radio-spectrum fee. It is held as its own record flagged `is_transfer: true` precisely because the anexo does not name the vote that carries the counterpart expenditure and it most plausibly nests inside this programme. · The named project inside the programme is `65.05.02.02.117 - Cabo Verde Digital`**, which appears only in the monthly `Alterações Orçamentais` virement register (Ministério da Economia Digital; reinforced CVE 1,000,000 and CVE 10,000 in December 2024 alone). No published mapa names it. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.

programme: Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)

purpose: `Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)` - the counterpart expenditure of the operator contribution and the radio-spectrum fee. The anexo prints the fund's name and its amount and nothing else.
scope_basis: Single-mandate fund - universal service and information-society development, financed by operator contributions and the radio-spectrum fee. Its whole appropriation is digital by mandate.
amount_scale: escudos (units), space thousands separator; the table totals 8,209,020,794 on both sides
doc_locator: Anexo Informativo do OE 2024, receitas consignadas table, item 10 `Contribuição das Operadoras de Comunicações e Taxa de Espetro Radioelétrico` -> `Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI)` 122,073,633, PDF p.63

doc_locator: Lei n.º 35/X/2023, `Mapa VII` (PDF p.109); outturn at `Conta Geral do Estado 2024`, `Mapa VII` (PDF pp.179-180)
notes: `Mapa VII - Despesa por Programa e Tipo de Financiamento` is the only table in the Cabo Verdean budget that states a digital line's **purpose** and its **financing origin** together. Its columns are `Tesouro | OFN (Outras Fontes Nacionais) | FCP AAL (Fundo de Contravalor / Ajuda Alimentar) | Donativo | Empréstimos | Total`. **`Tesouro + OFN` is the domestic-state share and is what this record carries**; `Donativo` and `Empréstimos` are external and are excluded by the origin gate. · Why the programme axis and not the ministry vote.** Cabo Verde publishes the vote (`Mapa III`) only as ministry x programme *type* (Investimento / Finalístico / Gestão e Apoio Administrativo) - a programme-type split, not a programme. `Mapa VII` is the finest published grain at which a line's stated purpose is digital, and it is the only one that prints the origin split. Recording both axes would double-count the same escudos, so the organic figures are carried here as context and are not separate records. · The organic axis, for context.** `Mapa III` gives `01.03.10 GOV - Ministério Da Modernização Do Estado E Da Administracao Publica` **OI CVE 368,989,734** (111,000,000 + 77,317,675 + 180,672,059) -> **ORP 514,874,529** (261,000,000 + 77,317,675 + 176,556,854) -> **EXE 185,024,373** (1,000,103 + 44,500,948 + 139,523,322) = **35.9% of ORP**. admin_head: NOSi, E.P.E. - Plano de Atividades e Orçamento 2024
spending_entity: NOSi, E.P.E. (Núcleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informação)
purpose: `Protocolos` - the line in NOSi's forecast service revenue covering inter-institutional protocols with state bodies. The plan prints the line title and the figure and no description.
scope_basis: Single-mandate body - NOSi is the state's digital agency and does nothing else; the `Protocolos` line is money state bodies pay it under inter-institutional protocols, so the whole line is domestic-state digital spend.
amount_scale: milhares de escudos (mCVE)** - the table header reads `Previsão de Receitas 2024 (mCVE)`. 333,345 mCVE = CVE 333,345,000. This is the only Cabo Verdean artefact in the whole country-year printed in thousands; every other one is in full escudos.
doc_locator: NOSi, E.P.E., `Plano de Atividades e Orçamento 2024`, section 5.1 `Previsão de Prestação de Serviços`, p.14, line `Protocolos`
notes: `is_transfer: true`.** This is money the state pays its own digital agency; the same escudos sit in the buying ministries' votes, which this pass records on the programme axis. Counting both would double-count within `domestic-state`. · NOSi's money is 73% the size of the whole digital ministry's vote and none of it is in that vote.** Forecast total revenue FY2024 CVE 1,016,801,000 against a `Ministério da Economia Digital` appropriation of CVE 1,390,965,632. Components (mCVE): Housing 22,860; IaaS 58,544; PaaS 5,294; SaaS 17,074; Comunicação 14,195; Acessórios 613; Bundled 49,014; **Protocolos 333,345**; Outro 16,689; Consultoria/Formação/Estágio 14,560; Certificados Digitais 721; Projetos 214,255; **Projetos Financiados 269,638**. The components sum to 1,016,802 against a printed total of 1,016,801 - a one-thousand-escudo rounding in the printed total, noted and not corrected. · `Projetos Financiados` CVE 269,638,000 is donor money and is excluded** by the origin gate; it is not carried in this record and no `non-state` record is built from it, because the plan names no financier. · Cybersecurity has no vote line in Cabo Verde and the money is inside NOSi.** The `PAO 2024` commits NOSi to "Implementar CSIRT RTPE e melhorar o ambiente de Cibersegurança Nacional" and to ISO-27001 certification of its PKI, from its own revenue. No cybersecurity rubric appears at any grain in the FY2024 budget, despite `Decreto-lei n.º 9/2021` and `Decreto-Regulamentar n.º 1/2021` creating the CSIRT. · Outturn now held, and the forecast was low.** *(Supersedes the note carried here until 2026-08-04, that NOSi's `Relatório e Contas` series stopped at 2023 and the FY2024 forecast could not be tested. The series does not stop at 2023 — the 2024 accounts are posted, and are now held as 2024-12-31-nosi-relatorio-de-gestao-e-contas-2024. The absence was in the library index, not in the record.)* `Serviços Protocolados c/ Estado` came in at **CVE 455,964,000 (2024)** against **CVE 333,345,000** board-budgeted — **136.8% of plan**, an overshoot of CVE 122,619,000. Total service revenue, by contrast, landed at **CVE 1,000,587,000 against CVE 1,016,801,000 forecast — 98.4%**, so the plan was accurate in aggregate and wrong in composition: the state bought materially more from its own digital agency under protocol than the agency expected to sell it. **FY2025 remains untested** — the accounts library runs 2016–2024 and the 2025 volume is not posted (as of 2026-08-04). · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.

notes: No appropriation stage held - baseline is `proposed`.** The receitas consignadas table is a statutory *anexo informativo* under `Lei n.º 55/IX/2019` art. 36 h), tabled with the bill on 29 September 2023. `Artigo 1.º` of `Lei n.º 35/X/2023` makes the anexos part of the budget, **but the enacted Boletim Oficial does not reprint this table** - a full-text search of the 128-page enacted volume returns no occurrence of `SNIAC`, `Passaporte`, `Serviço Universal` or the figure 306,516,802. The enacted value of this line is therefore not established. · This is the table that closes a three-year gap in the CPV series.** All three CPV sweeps recorded that no line for a population register, CRVS, national identity card, biometric enrolment or passport system appears at any published grain, and generalised the absence to a regional pattern with Comoros and Congo. **That was true of `Mapa III`, `Mapa IV` and the FSA mapas and false of the anexo informativo.** The FY2026 run found the table in the FY2026 law and flagged the FY2024 and FY2025 volumes as a re-read; this record is the result of that re-read. **The identity money was in the FY2024 package all along, at the same figures the FY2026 law prints.** · The line is real in execution, not only on paper.** `50.01.01.01.109.01 - Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil - SNIAC`, under `GOV - Ministério Da Justiça`, carries virements in the December 2024 `Alterações Orçamentais` register (CVE 427,245 cancelled). · No double count with the programme-axis records.** The SNIAC lines sit in the Ministério da Justiça perimeter, inside the *Justiça e Paz Social* programme, which this pass does not record. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.

spending_tier_name: Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados
spending_entity: Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados (CNPD)
purpose: `CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados)` - a line under `OUTRAS DESP. CORRENTES-ORGÃOS EXTERNOS` in the Assembly's Orçamento Privativo. The resolution prints the body's name, its dotacao and its own revenue and nothing else; there is no stated purpose to quote.
scope_basis: Single-mandate body - the driver's envelope carve-out. The CNPD's entire statutory mandate is personal-data protection, so its whole appropriation is the data-governance line and the figure is recoverable from no sub-line.
amount_scale: escudos (units), '.' thousands separator, no scale header
doc_locator: Resolução n.º 135/X/2023 (Orçamento Privativo da Assembleia Nacional), published with Lei n.º 35/X/2023 at BO I Serie n.º 134 p.2816, heading `OUTRAS DESP. CORRENTES-ORGÃOS EXTERNOS`: `CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados) 35.255.451`, `Dotação inscrita no Orçamento do Estado 35.255.451`, `Receita Próprias 0`
notes: The data-protection authority is appropriated through the legislature, not the executive, and that is what makes it findable at all.** It sits in the Assembly's own private budget as an *orgao externo*, alongside `ARC (Autoridade Reguladora para Comunicação Social)` 87,210,101, `Provedor de Justiça` 39,871,455 and `CNE` 35,760,297. **A cross-vote scan of the ministerial `Mapa III` alone would report that Cabo Verde does not fund its data-protection authority.** Cabo Verde remains the only state in this collection whose DPA has a locatable, dated, domestic appropriation. · The authority has no own-source revenue at all** - `Receita Próprias 0` - unlike the levy-funded regulator pattern found across the francophone corpus. · Its running costs are domestic and its programme money is not.** `TdR - Estratégia de Comunicação da CNPD`, February 2024, is issued by the finance ministry's UGPE under a **US$20 million World Bank credit** (the Digital Cabo Verde project). The CNPD's own `Plano de Atividades 2024` contains no budget figures at all. · No outturn is published for this line, as at 2026-08-04.** The `Conta Geral do Estado 2024` reports the Assembly as one organic row (OI 1,170,329,912 -> ORP 1,181,121,540 -> EXE 1,024,176,342, 86.7%) and does not break out the *orgaos externos*. **The CNPD's FY2024 execution is not established.** · A second, unrelated CNPD line exists and is not this one.** `02.06.03.08 CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Protecção de Dados) 945.000` appears in `Mapa IX` - a transfer line, an order of magnitude smaller, and not the authority's appropriation. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average CVE/USD rate is held; the escudo is pegged to the euro (110.265 CVE/EUR), so a dollar figure would be a two-step conversion the wiki cannot date to a named source.
